Libraries used by the free PDF-to-Excel page. They are stored with the site
so the page does not load them from a third party. The PDF a visitor chooses
is never uploaded; these files only read and write it in the browser.

pdf.js 4.10.38 legacy build (Mozilla)
https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
Apache-2.0, see pdfjs/LICENSE
pdfjs/pdf.min.mjs
  sha256 44ec6f011027ee77791386b66c14876a5fc29e20bf0433c07c6726fff7212b72
pdfjs/pdf.worker.min.mjs
  sha256 bd88805178a26c729db8c0107a5b630cb900ec070f4d8c7529a3e45530afd41d
